Celestial.description: Blessed with holy spiritual energy from celestial realms.

features.name: Celestial Kitsune
features.tldr: You gain an innate divine cantrip and bonus protection against evil effects.

Wild.description: Deeply connected to untamed forests and foxfire magic.

features.name: Wild Kitsune
features.tldr: You can manifest magical foxfire to illuminate areas or strike foes.
